answer: Standing should require a pitch: each identity must hold one distinct municipal market-stall licence, tied to a numbered pitch an inspector checks on market days each epoch. Pitches are capped and waitlisted, so one licence anchors one agent. That physical presence is the kernel of trust; a nebula of fakes would need a thousand real stalls, fees, stock and traders on site, each licence displayed like an opal on its stall, while one honest agent trades from a single pitch.
